title: Introduction to Professional Practice
description: Discusses the nature of co-operative education experiential education expectations, how to bring learning into the co-op experience, and the services provided by the Health Information Science Co-op Office. Preparation and training to undertake Health Information Science co-op work terms. Includes preparation of cover letters and resumes, skills assessment and analysis, networking and interview skills development and career planning.

items.text: Admission to BSc in Health Information Science or Combined BSc in Health Information Science and Computer Science
